Police Commemoration Day observed at Tirunelveli City Armed Reserve Police Ground in Palayamkottai in Wednesday. | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT
The Police Commemoration Day was observed here on Wednesday.
Led by Commissioner of Police, Tirunelveli City, Deshmukh Shekhar Sanjay, senior police officers, including Deputy Inspector General of Police, Tirunelveli Range, R. Thirunavukkarasu, Superintendent of `Police, Tirunelveli, Vishwesh Balasubramanian Shastri, Deputy Commissioners of Police, Tirunelveli City, S. Saravanan and D. Ramesh Babu and others placed wreath on the decorated memorial column in the Tirunelveli City Armed Reserve Police Ground in Palayamkottai.
The Mr. Sanjay and other police officers honoured the family members of the policemen who died in harness and inquired about their grievances, if any.
In Tenkasi district, Collector Ranjeet Singh, Superintendent of Police S. Ashok Kumar, senior police officers and the family members of the policemen who died in harness placed wreath on the memorial column in the Aayikudi police station campus.
The Collector and the Superintendent of Police also met the family members of the policemen.
